title: 颜色交替的最短路径
summary: 有向图边为红或蓝，求从零号节点到每个节点且相邻边颜色交替的最短路径，不可达记负一。
insight: 状态必须包含节点和上一条边颜色；从 (0,red) 与 (0,blue) 同时距离零出发，每次只沿相反颜色边扩展。
pitfalls: 同一节点以上一颜色不同是两个独立状态
平行边和自环按状态去重即可

solutions.title: 节点与末边颜色 BFS
solutions.idea: 在扩展状态图上求无权最短路。
steps: 分别构建 redGraph、blueGraph，distance[n][2] 初始化 -1
将 (0,0)、(0,1) 距离设零并入队
弹 (node,lastColor)，nextColor=1-last；沿对应图，对未访问 (neighbor,nextColor) 写 distance+1 并入队；答案取两色最小非负值

code.java: class Solution { public int[] shortestAlternatingPaths(int n,int[][] redEdges,int[][] blueEdges){List<Integer>[][] graph=new List[2][n];for(int color=0;color<2;color++)for(int i=0;i<n;i++)graph[color][i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] edge:redEdges)graph[0][edge[0]].add(edge[1]);for(int[] edge:blueEdges)graph[1][edge[0]].add(edge[1]);int[][] distance=new int[n][2];for(int[] row:distance)Arrays.fill(row,-1);Queue<int[]> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int color=0;color<2;color++){distance[0][color]=0;queue.offer(new int[]{0,color});}while(!queue.isEmpty()){int[] state=queue.poll();int nextColor=1-state[1];for(int next:graph[nextColor][state[0]])if(distance[next][nextColor]<0){distance[next][nextColor]=distance[state[0]][state[1]]+1;queue.offer(new int[]{next,nextColor});}}int[] answer=new int[n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)answer[i]=distance[i][0]<0?distance[i][1]:distance[i][1]<0?distance[i][0]:Math.min(distance[i][0],distance[i][1]);return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun shortestAlternatingPaths(n:Int,redEdges:Array<IntArray>,blueEdges:Array<IntArray>):IntArray{val graph=Array(2){Array(n){mutableListOf<Int>()}};for(edge in redEdges)graph[0][edge[0]].add(edge[1]);for(edge in blueEdges)graph[1][edge[0]].add(edge[1]);val distance=Array(n){intArrayOf(-1,-1)};val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();for(color in 0..1){distance[0][color]=0;queue.addLast(intArrayOf(0,color))};while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val state=queue.removeFirst();val nextColor=1-state[1];for(next in graph[nextColor][state[0]])if(distance[next][nextColor]<0){distance[next][nextColor]=distance[state[0]][state[1]]+1;queue.addLast(intArrayOf(next,nextColor))}};return IntArray(n){i->when{distance[i][0]<0->distance[i][1];distance[i][1]<0->distance[i][0];else->minOf(distance[i][0],distance[i][1])}}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<int> shortestAlternatingPaths(int n,vector<vector<int>>& redEdges,vector<vector<int>>& blueEdges){vector<vector<vector<int>>> graph(2,vector<vector<int>>(n));for(auto& edge:redEdges)graph[0][edge[0]].push_back(edge[1]);for(auto& edge:blueEdges)graph[1][edge[0]].push_back(edge[1]);vector<array<int,2>> distance(n,array<int,2>{-1,-1});queue<pair<int,int>> pending;for(int color=0;color<2;++color){distance[0][color]=0;pending.push({0,color});}while(!pending.empty()){auto [node,lastColor]=pending.front();pending.pop();int nextColor=1-lastColor;for(int next:graph[nextColor][node])if(distance[next][nextColor]<0){distance[next][nextColor]=distance[node][lastColor]+1;pending.push({next,nextColor});}}vector<int> answer(n);for(int i=0;i<n;++i)answer[i]=distance[i][0]<0?distance[i][1]:distance[i][1]<0?distance[i][0]:min(distance[i][0],distance[i][1]);return answer;} };
